(NR) "Art. 10.................................................................... § 1o All documents and studies that are specific to the national context, including evidence related to differences in target population, epidemiology and other characteristics of the disease, in addition to medicinal products used concomitantly and other factors that may significantly affect the benefit risk profile of a product, as well as possible specific quality parameters, shall be subject to abbreviated analysis when there is a difference between the information and the scope of the request for optimized analysis submitted to Anvisa and those that have been previously approved by the AREA. § 3o In the framework of the optimized analysis procedure, the abbreviated analysis shall be limited to the critical points where there are differences between the information, conditions or scope approved by the AIRE and those submitted to Anvisa in the corresponding request for regulation or post-regulation." (NR) "
translation_review.checked_translation: Article 9. Specific requests for optimised analysis shall be assessed by the technical area for eligibility. Article 10 [intervening text omitted in the source amendment]. Paragraph 1. All documents and studies specific to the national context must undergo the ordinary analysis route, including evidence about differences in the target population, epidemiology and other disease characteristics, concomitant medicines and other factors that may significantly affect the product's benefit–risk profile, and any specific quality parameters. Paragraph 2. Abridged analysis applies when the information and scope of the optimised-analysis request submitted to Anvisa differ from those previously approved by the equivalent foreign regulatory authority (AREE). Paragraph 3. Within optimised analysis, abridged analysis is limited to critical points where the information, conditions or scope approved by the AREE differ from those submitted to Anvisa in the corresponding registration or post-registration request.
translation_review.check_note: Material repair: machine output merged paragraphs 1 and 2 and incorrectly assigned abridged analysis to national-context evidence; original requires ordinary analysis. Restored separate paragraphs and critical-difference limitation.
